item.title: HC fixes next hearing on split verdict Jan 20

item.title: Fakhrul seeks intervention of Army Chief

item.title: FIFA World Cup trophy now in Bangladesh
item.description: The original FIFA World Cup trophy has arrived in Dhaka.Around 10AM on Wednesday, the trophy landed at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
